storyCards.fact:
Drake's "Nice For What" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Nice for What" is a song recorded by Canadian rapper Drake from his fifth studio album Scorpion (2018).

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 25 weeks on the chart.

Nice For What was released in 2018.
